toml:
# Map-error Monte Carlo on the 60-minute GPS-denied gravity-map benchmark (WP-10, RM-15).
#
# Every parameter is `gps-denied-gravity-nav.toml`'s, unchanged. The `[map_error_mc]` block
# then reruns the benchmark over seeded realisations of a Gaussian-correlated error added to
# the STORED map (the gravimeter still measures the true field): realisation k uses map-error
# seed `seed + k` and gravimeter-noise seed `noise_seed + k`. The document adds a
# `map_error_mc` block with the distribution of the matched error (mean, median, 95th
# percentile, max, and the fraction within `target_m`). The single-run fields are the
# benchmark's own, with no map error. MODELLED: the error statistics are an assumption, not
# a survey's.

# Dispatched by the scenario engine as `kind = "gravity-map"` (also consumed directly by
# `run_gps_denied_gravity_nav` in the unit tests, which ignore this field).
kind = "gravity-map"

# Maximum spherical-harmonic degree/order of the reference field.
nmax = 3

# Track flown GPS-denied: 90 waypoints, 40 s gravimeter averaging each ⇒ 3600 s = 60 min.
# An oblique leg keeps the scalar gravimeter sequence observable in both north and east.
start_lat_deg = 10.0
start_lon_deg = 20.0
step_lat_deg = 0.06
step_lon_deg = 0.045
waypoints = 90

# True constant INS position drift accumulated over the one-hour outage (≈ 70 km at ~13° lat,
# i.e. far past the 10 km the matched solution must beat).
drift_lat_deg = 0.5
drift_lon_deg = -0.4

# Cold-atom gravimeter: 1e-7 m/s²/√Hz ASD (≈10 µGal/√Hz), 40 s averaging ⇒ σ ≈ 1.6e-3 mGal.
gravimeter_asd = 1.0e-7
averaging_time_s = 40.0

# Map/representation error (mGal): combined with the sensor white noise into the matching σ.
map_sigma_mgal = 2.0

# Hierarchical offset search: ±0.8° at 0.08° to start, then three coarse-to-fine stages each
# shrinking the window and step 8× ⇒ final offset resolution 0.08° / 8² ≈ 140 m.
search_half_deg = 0.8
search_step_deg = 0.08
refine_stages = 3
refine_factor = 8.0
noise_seed = 1

# Low-degree anomalous, fully-normalised coefficients (the always-on regional trend).
[[coeffs]]
n = 2
m = 0
cbar = 6.0e-6
sbar = 0.0

[[coeffs]]
n = 3
m = 1
cbar = 3.0e-6
sbar = 2.0e-6

# Localized Gaussian anomalies (mascons) the track crosses — the distinctive high-degree
# features that make the constant drift observable.
[[mascons]]
lat_deg = 11.0
lon_deg = 20.8
amp_mgal = 45.0
sigma_deg = 0.30

[[mascons]]
lat_deg = 12.4
lon_deg = 21.9
amp_mgal = -38.0
sigma_deg = 0.28

[[mascons]]
lat_deg = 13.8
lon_deg = 23.0
amp_mgal = 50.0
sigma_deg = 0.32

# 20 map-error realisations: 2 mGal 1-sigma (the matcher's own map_sigma_mgal budget), with
# a correlation length of 0.2 deg (about 22 km, the scale of the mascons it corrupts), on a
# 0.02 deg error lattice (a tenth of that length).
[map_error_mc]
realisations = 20
sigma_mgal = 2.0
correlation_length_deg = 0.2
grid_step_deg = 0.02
seed = 1
target_m = 500.0
summary: gravity-map | free-inertial drift 70607 m | gravity-matched 144 m | matching sigma 2.000e0 mGal | map-error MC x20 p95 14744 m, 5% within 500 m
